text:
Airflow checks at midday stayed on our minds, and it was good to get your report from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. Your complaint says your pet area ran too hot during the flight, the handling felt careless, and you want this fixed fast because the situation should never have reached your companion.

I am sorry this landed on you and on your animal. We take cabin comfort seriously, and when a pet is exposed to overheating, every part of the response has to be quick, calm, and documented. <<FACT F117>> Please keep any follow-up notes tied to the same report so we can move this through without delay. We are already flagging the cabin crew record, the temperature review, and the animal care log for the shift team.

<<FACT F111>>

What we can say right now is that your concern is being treated as urgent. The desk is pushing for a clean review of the carrier placement, the airflow pattern, and the handoff process, because if any step broke down, we need to know it and correct it. If your companion showed any signs of stress after landing, send that along in plain words and include any vet note you have, since that helps us build the case and keep the record solid. If your complaint also includes damaged gear or missed service, list that clearly in the same message so nothing gets split apart.

I know that does not erase the stress you dealt with, but it does mean your report is now in the active queue and being handled by people who understand how serious pet travel problems are. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will keep the review moving and will not leave this hanging.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
